arxiv-2112-05245.title: On the maximum volume of collapsing structures
arxiv-2112-05245.creator: Ismael Delgado Gaspar
arxiv-2112-05245.description: Abstract In many cosmological models, including the Λ \Lambda CDM concordance model, there exist theoretical upper bounds on the size of collapsing structures. The most common formulations in the literature refer to a turnaround radius in spherical symmetry or a turnaround surface, defined as the zero-expansion boundary separating the outer Hubble flow from the inner flow of a collapsing fluid.

arxiv-2208-10630.title: Fault Current-Constrained Optimal Power Flow on Unbalanced Distribution Networks
arxiv-2208-10630.creator: Jose E. Tabarez, Arthur K. Barnes, Adam Mate, Russell W. Bent
arxiv-2208-10630.description: Abstract With the proliferation of distributed generation into distribution networks, the need to consider fault currents in the dispatch problem becomes increasingly relevant. This paper introduces a method for adding fault current constraints into optimal power flow in order to reduce fault currents while minimizing generation cost.

arxiv-2301-04330.title: Fast Kinodynamic Planning on the Constraint Manifold with Deep Neural Networks PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2022 IEEE
arxiv-2301-04330.creator: Piotr Kicki, Puze Liu, Davide Tateo, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Krzysztof Walas, Piotr Skrzypczyński, Jan Peters
arxiv-2301-04330.description: Abstract Motion planning is a mature area of research in robotics with many well-established methods based on optimization or sampling the state space, suitable for solving kinematic motion planning. However, when dynamic motions under constraints are needed and computation time is limited, fast kinodynamic planning on the constraint manifold is indispensable.

arxiv-2307-09670.title: JAZZVAR: A Dataset of Variations found within Solo Piano Performances of Jazz Standards for Music Overpainting
arxiv-2307-09670.creator: Eleanor Row, Jingjing Tang, György Fazekas
arxiv-2307-09670.description: Abstract Jazz pianists often uniquely interpret jazz standards. Passages from these interpretations can be viewed as sections of variation. We manually extracted such variations from solo jazz piano performances. The JAZZVAR dataset is a collection of 502 pairs of ‘ Original ’ and ‘ Variation ’ MIDI segments.

arxiv-2309-04770.title: After-Fatigue Condition: A Novel Analysis Based on Surface EMG Signals
arxiv-2309-04770.creator: \IEEEauthorblockN Van-Hieu Nguyen 1 , Gia Thien Luu 2,∗ , Thien Van Luong 1 , Mai Xuan Trang 1 \IEEEauthorblockN Philippe RAVIER 3 , Olivier BUTTELLI 3 \IEEEauthorblockA 1 Faculty of Computer Science, Phenikaa University, Hanoi 12116, Vietnam 2 Biomedical Engineering Department, HUTECH Institute of
arxiv-2309-04770.description: Abstract This study introduces a novel muscle activation analysis based on surface electromyography (sEMG) signals to assess the muscle’s after-fatigue condition. Previous studies have mainly focused on the before-fatigue and fatigue conditions. However, a comprehensive analysis of the after-fatigue condition has been overlooked.

arxiv-2403-03684.title: Quantifying Media Influence on Covid-19 Mask-Wearing Beliefs
arxiv-2403-03684.creator: Nicholas Rabb, Nitya Nadgir, Jan P. de Ruiter, Lenore Cowen
arxiv-2403-03684.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Rabb, Nitya Nadgir, Jan P. de Ruiter, Lenore Cowen. How political beliefs change in accordance with media exposure is a complicated matter. Some studies have been able to demonstrate that groups with different media diets in the aggregate (e.g., U.S. media consumers ingesting partisan news) arrive at different beliefs about policy issues, but proving this from data at a granular level – at the level of attitudes expressed in news stories – remains difficult.

arxiv-2410-16260.title: Multi-product Zeno effect achieving higher order convergence rates
arxiv-2410-16260.creator: Tim Möbus
arxiv-2410-16260.description: Abstract The quantum Zeno effect is a fundamental mechanism for implementing the effective dynamics of projected Hamiltonian and Lindbladian systems. It approximates the target projected evolution by interleaving Hamiltonian or Lindblad dynamics with quantum operations associated with the desired subspace.

arxiv-2503-18047.creator: Sergey Avvakumov, Alfredo Hubard
arxiv-2503-18047.description: Abstract . For each d ≥ 3 d\geq 3 we construct cube complexes homeomorphic to the d d -sphere with n n vertices in which the number of facets (assuming d d constant) is Ω ⁡ ( n 5 / 4 ) \Omega(n^{5/4}) .

arxiv-2510-11057.title: Temporal Alignment Guidance: On-manifold Sampling in Diffusion Models
arxiv-2510-11057.creator: Youngrok Park, Hojung Jung, Sangmin Bae, Se-Young Yun
arxiv-2510-11057.description: Abstract Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success as generative models. However, even a well-trained model can accumulate errors throughout the generation process. These errors become particularly problematic when arbitrary guidance is applied to steer samples toward desired properties, which often breaks sample fidelity. In this paper, we propose a general solution to address the off-manifold phenomenon observed in diffusion models.

pmc-10641463.title: Evidence from a meta-analysis and systematic review reveals the global prevalence of mild cognitive impairment
pmc-10641463.creator: Wen-xin Song, Wei-wei Wu, Yuan-yuan Zhao, Hai-lun Xu, Guan-cheng Chen, Shan-yu Jin, Jie Chen, Shao-xiang Xian, Jing-hong Liang
pmc-10641463.description: ObjectiveMild cognitive impairment (MCI) is a preclinical and transitional stage between healthy ageing and dementia. The purpose of our study was to investigate the recent pooled global prevalence of MCI.MethodsThis meta-analysis was in line with the recommendations of Cochrane’s Handbook and Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020.

pmc-11394452.title: Cattle Body Size Measurement Based on DUOS–PointNet++
pmc-11394452.creator: Zhi Weng, Wenzhi Lin, Zhiqiang Zheng, Victor E Cabrera
pmc-11394452.description: Simple SummaryIn intelligent agriculture, non-contact, automatic body size measurement is widely used for livestock. However, the common measurement methods based on the whole point cloud are complex and prone to errors because of the positions of the cattle. To measure the body sizes of livestock more accurately, a cattle body measuring system is proposed.

pmc-11478248.title: Sodium-Ion Battery at Low Temperature: Challenges and Strategies
pmc-11478248.creator: Yan Zhao, Zhen Zhang, Yalong Zheng, Yichao Luo, Xinyu Jiang, Yaru Wang, Zhoulu Wang, Yutong Wu, Yi Zhang, Xiang Liu, Baizeng Fang, Carlos Miguel Costa
pmc-11478248.description: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) have garnered significant interest due to their potential as viable alternatives to conventional lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), particularly in environments where low-temperature (LT) performance is crucial. This paper provides a comprehensive review of current research on LT SIBs, focusing on electrode materials, electrolytes, and operational challenges specific to sub-zero conditions.

pmc-12613101.title: Obesity effects on the health-related quality of life in Japan: Implications from a cross-sectional study
pmc-12613101.creator: Takako Kaneyasu, Hideki Murasawa
pmc-12613101.description: ObjectivesObesity is a global health problem owing to its association with various diseases, in turn requiring various treatment modalities, including expensive drugs and surgeries. In Japan, the obese population is relatively small, thus the impact of the disease is considered to be smaller than that in other countries.

pmc-12684758.title: Trajectories of cumulative fluid balance and the association with pressure injuries in ICU patients
pmc-12684758.creator: Xiangping Chen, Peiqi Liu, Bingyan Zhu, Xiumin Qiu, Wei Yu, Yuewen Lao, Xiaoyan Gong, Yiyu Zhuang
pmc-12684758.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the longitudinal trajectories of cumulative fluid balance (CFB) in intensive care unit (ICU) patients and analyze the relationship between different trajectory groups and the occurrence of pressure injuries (PIs).MethodsIn this retrospective longitudinal study, we obtained health-related data from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV database, including sociodemographic, disease-related variables, and ICU treatment variables.

pmc-12748388.title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis to elucidate cellular communication in the microenvironment of breast cancer
pmc-12748388.creator: Man Wang, Hua Li, Xingong Zhang, Zhijian Zha, Mengjia Zhao, Qi Wang, Danfeng Zhang
pmc-12748388.description: BackgroundBreast cancer (BC) is the most common malignancy among women, with an increasing incidence correlated with age and diverse subtypes exhibiting distinct prognoses. The tumor microenvironment (TME) in BC is complicated. It is now believed that BC may acquire invasive characteristics and even extra proliferative ability from the TME through various mechanisms.

pmc-13126480.title: Shoulder and genetics: what orthopedic surgeons need to know
pmc-13126480.creator: Ulas Can Kolac, Alp Paksoy, Dilsu Dicle Erkan, Doruk Akgun
pmc-13126480.description: Common shoulder disorders are a major source of pain and disability worldwide. Although mechanical overload, degeneration, and trauma are well-recognized contributors, substantial variability in disease onset, severity, and response to treatment suggests that biological and inherited factors may also influence disease susceptibility and progression.

pmc-13163199.title: Acetate uptake alleviates propionate-mediated growth restriction in Yersinia enterocolitica
pmc-13163199.creator: Matthew K. Muramatsu, Dylan Cole, Sebastian J. Perez-Orozco, Sebastian E. Winter
pmc-13163199.description: The gut microbiota impedes infection by enteric pathogens, a process termed colonization resistance. Microbial production of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), such as acetate, propionate, and butyrate, contributes to colonization resistance. Yersinia enterocolitica encounters short-chain fatty acids at several stages during intestinal infection. However, our understanding of how Y. enterocolitica copes with SCFA stress is limited.
